mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it indicates a tight labor market that boosts corporate profits and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which together predict positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with rising PAYEMS, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1650 thousand units, it indicates strong residential construction activity that boosts economic growth and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1650, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal a monetary policy response to overheating, which together predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansion, a rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates improving manufacturing activity that supports economic growth and equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods classified as early-cycle expansion with rising INDPRO, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.
